title: Access to Debt and the Provision of Trade Credit
authors: Matthew T. Billett; Kayla M. Freeman; Janet Gao
eligible_reason: Staggered adoption of state anti-recharacterization laws (binary s_law by supplier state of incorporation, 7 adopting states at different years, with never-treated and always-treated suppliers). Three main-text columns regress outcomes on s_law alone with unit and calendar-time FE and no controls: Table 2 Panel B col 1 (pair-level trade credit, supplier FE + customer-by-year FE) and Table 5 Panel C cols 1 and 4 (supplier-level margins and profitability, supplier FE + year FE), all clustered by state of incorporation. Other columns add time-varying controls, a second treatment (customer's law c_law), PPML, entropy-balanced stacked samples, IV, or treatment-intensity regressors.
design_notes: Three analysis panels: finalSEC.dta (hand-collected SEC supplier-customer trade credit, pair-year 1993-2010, 5,405 obs), finalSegmentSupplier.dta (supplier-year 1992-2010, 21,704 obs), finalCompustat.dta (firm-year, 105,745 obs, used only with controls in Table 6). s_law switches on once per supplier (no switch-off coded despite the 2003 Reaves decision). Second shock in the abstract corresponds to leverage/IV analysis (Table 4) and stacked entropy-balanced event sample (finalStacked.dta: Table 3 Panel C, Table 4, Figure 4 with pweight = eweight and event#year, cs_id#event FE). Table 2 Panel A and Table 6 Panel C include both s_law and c_law. Tables 7-10 use continuous treated_csale (share of sales to treated customers) and interactions. Clustering: s_incorp (34 states in finalSEC, 50 in segment file).
estimators_reported: TWFE static with supplier FE and customer-by-year FE or year FE (Tables 2, 5C, 6, 7, 8)
entropy-balanced stacked event-sample DiD with pweights (Table 3C, Figure 4)
IV ivreghdfe with s_law instrumenting leverage (Table 4)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: finalSegmentSupplier: switching cohorts 1998, 2002, 2003, 2005, 2006, 2007 (6); finalSEC: 1998, 2002, 2003, 2005, 2006 (5) plus states entering already treated.
always_treated_note: finalSEC: 313 of 969 suppliers always treated; finalSegmentSupplier: 670 of 4,419.
modern_estimators_named: stacked event-sample DiD with entropy balancing (Table 3C, Table 4, Figure 4; not CSA/BJS)
reports_modern_estimator_note: Stacked design reported; no CSA/BJS/SA/dCDH. Full-text flags cite Goodman-Bacon, Callaway-Sant'Anna and Baker et al.
